management_text: Three equal units. Unit 1 exits at TP1 7,604.7 (entry +1R, +58.3 pts). Unit 2 exits at TP2 7,663.0 (entry +2R, +116.6 pts); on the Unit 2 fill the Unit 3 stop moves to entry +0.2R = 7,558.1 (+11.7 pts). R = 58.3 pts = 0.77 x ATR14, so no wide-stop flag is due; 2R = 116.6 pts is inside 3 x ATR14 = 227.3, so no ambitious-TP2 flag is due. Thesis invalidation, distinct from the stop: a daily close below 7,472.8 (prior-session daily S3), 15.3 pts beyond the stop = 0.20 x ATR14. Caveats: prior-session intraday H/L are single-source indicative, so the pivot levels cited as confluences carry the indicative qualifier; the entry price is a prior-close proxy for the anchor open; the holding period collides with the 15 Jul PPI print and the Fed-chair testimony, both high-impact on the scheduled calendar.
rationale: REFERENCE CLOSE. The last completed primary-asset session strictly before D (2026-07-15) is Tue 14 Jul 2026. On the report's own declared price basis (cash regular session, 09:30-16:00 ET = 16:30-23:00 broker) that session's settled close is 7,546.40. Every level below is built on that one number. The report body prints 7,543.59 for the same close; the slice cash close is 7,546.40 (delta -2.81, inside the 3-point close tolerance but not identical), and the rule that a MARKET entry equals the reference close means the entry moves to the slice value, not the report's. BASIS AND ATR14. ATR14 = 75.77 index points, 14 sessions ending 14 Jul 2026, computed on cash-session bars (16:30-23:00 broker) with TR = max(H-L, |H-prevC|, |L-prevC|). The same figure is used for every buffer, cap, tier and flag on this card. The full-broker-day basis (00:00-23:45) gives 83.42; the cash basis is used because the report defines the instrument as the cash index over the NYSE/NASDAQ regular session and excludes pre/after-market. The report never states ATR14 as a number and implies two different values (78.5 from its 3xATR cap, ~70 from its backtest bands); both are discarded. DIRECTION. Regime label TRANSITION (Kaufman trending-up vs a negative volatility slope, dual-gate fall-through) with a directional conviction score of +0.42, above the 0.25 conviction threshold, so LONG and not suppressed. ENTRY. Market at the 07:00 UK anchor = 09:00 broker; fill = reference close 7,546.40. STOP. Tighter of (a) 5-day swing low 7,421.10 (session low of Wed 08 Jul 2026, inside the 5-session block 08-14 Jul) less a 0.25 x ATR14 buffer = 7,421.10 - 18.94 = 7,402.16, and (b) nearest support in the 5-day structure, the session low of Mon 13 Jul 2026 at 7,507.00, less the same buffer = 7,507.00 - 18.94 = 7,488.06, rounded on the price grid to 7,488.1. (b) is tighter, so stop = 7,488.1. The report anchored this stop on 7,503.0, which is the derived-CFD indicative low for 13 Jul; the slice cash low for that session is 7,507.00, which moves the stop up 4.7 points. The 14 Jul low 7,512.9 sits in the same shelf but the report's own support narrative names the 13 Jul low, so 7,507.00 is the anchor used. R = 7,546.40 - 7,488.1 = 58.3 points = 0.77 x ATR14, inside the 3.5 x ATR14 structural cap of 265.2 and inside the 0.3-3.0 x ATR14 band of 22.73-227.31. TARGETS. TP1 = entry + 1R = 7,604.7; TP2 = entry + 2R = 7,663.0; on the TP2 fill the Unit 3 stop moves to entry + 0.2R = 7,558.1. TP3 = the runner's 3 x ATR14 price cap = 7,546.40 + 227.31 = 7,773.7, taken in preference to a null so the record and the card carry one value; the session-close time-stop applies first if it triggers first. TP1 sits 58.3 points from entry, well inside the 2.5 x ATR14 reachability band of 189.4. PIVOTS. Floor-trader formula P = (H+L+C)/3 on the prior period's high, low and close; the prior period for the daily set is the D-1 cash session of 14 Jul 2026 (H 7,559.70 / L 7,512.90 / C 7,546.40), giving P 7,539.67, R1 7,566.43, R2 7,586.47, R3 7,613.23, S1 7,519.63, S2 7,492.87, S3 7,472.83. The report built its daily set from 13 Jul (D-2) and is not used. Weekly, from the prior week 06-10 Jul cash (H 7,579.50 / L 7,421.10 / C 7,574.20): P 7,524.93, R1 7,628.77, S1 7,470.37. CONFLUENCES. Entry 7,546.40 sits 6.73 points above daily P 7,539.67 = 0.09 x ATR14, inside the 0.15 x ATR14 confluence tolerance - a balance-point confluence. TP1 7,604.7 sits 8.53 points below daily R3 7,613.23 = 0.11 x ATR14, also inside tolerance. The report's claim that TP1 is near daily R2 is not carried: R2 on the corrected prior period is 7,586.47, 18.2 points away. Stop 7,488.1 has no pivot inside tolerance; its anchor is the 13 Jul session low. NO FIB LEVELS are cited on this card - the fib swing anchor is a Trade 3A/3B input and neither variant is active in this regime. INVALIDATION. A daily close below daily S3 7,472.83, a named structural level, 15.3 points beyond the stop (0.20 x ATR14, more than the 0.15 x ATR14 minimum separation).

rationale: SUPPRESSED. Trigger fired: all accessible pivot tiers are single-source indicative. Value that fired it: the report states in its pivot section and again in its source-discipline section that the prior-period high, low and close behind every daily, weekly and monthly pivot tier come from a single derived (CFD) feed and that every tier therefore carries the indicative flag and cannot be used as a corroborated limit level. Only the closes for 13 and 14 Jul were corroborated by a second source; no high or low was, so no tier can be recomputed from corroborated prior-period H/L/C, and the absent-versus-indicative carve-out does not rescue it. The suppression test is symmetric - a report that states every tier is indicative must suppress the card - and the gate is non-overridable by any run-time instruction. SECOND, INDEPENDENT GROUND. Regime label is TRANSITION, under which the only permitted Trade 2 is a breakout-side entry aligned with the momentum-breakout variant; a counter-side limit is suppressed rather than re-labelled. The breakout is not confirmed: the 25-session boundary on the slice is 7,583.40 high (15 Jun 2026) / 7,260.00 low (11 Jun 2026), and a confirmed break needs a daily close beyond a boundary by at least 0.25 x ATR14 = 18.94 points, i.e. a close at or above 7,602.34 or at or below 7,241.06. The reference close of 7,546.40 (14 Jul 2026 cash session) is 55.94 points short of the upside trigger. So no breakout-side entry is eligible, and no compliant ladder exists in any case: a long stop-entry must sit at or above the reference close 7,546.40, while the trend-branch formula the report actually used, P + 0.10 x (R1 - P) = 7,539.67 + 0.10 x 26.76 = 7,542.35 on the corrected D-1 prior period, sits 4.05 points below it - wrong side of the reference close - and the daily R1 7,566.43, R1.5 7,576.45 and R2 7,586.47 targets all sit below the 7,583.40 boundary that would have to be cleared first, inverting the ladder. REFERENCE CLOSE AND BASIS, for the record: 7,546.40 on Tue 14 Jul 2026, cash session 16:30-23:00 broker; ATR14 = 75.77 points on the same 14 cash sessions ending at that close. Anchor 07:00 UK = 09:00 broker, unchanged from the fixed instance value. No level fields are populated.

The 25-session range on the slice, measured on cash-session bars over the 25 sessions ending 14 Jul 2026, is high 7,583.40 (Mon 15 Jun 2026) to low 7,260.00 (Thu 11 Jun 2026), width 323.40 points. A confirmed break requires a daily close beyond a boundary by at least 0.25 x ATR14 = 0.25 x 75.77 = 18.94 points, i.e. at or above 7,602.34 on the upside or at or below 7,241.06 on the downside. Neither boundary is broken, so the trade is not eligible and the card is emitted as a suppressed row with no entry, stop, R or ladder. The report's own body reached the same conclusion in its log but printed the card as a bare heading with no suppression row; that omission is corrected here.
